name: Atonia Blues
source:
The game begins when the player and his wife, have escaped from raiders who have destroyed their settlement.

They must now find a safe place to live. Along the way, they will meet the player's main rival,
who seems to have ulterior motives in helping the couple.

[From F95Zone]
